subject.title: [codex] fix(sessions): report archive cleanup in sessions cleanup

question: Should this PR land with `sessions cleanup` deleting/reporting stale deleted/reset archive files through the existing archive-retention rules?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and proven, but the affected files are session transcript artifacts and the repository treats session-state cleanup as maintainer-risk-sensitive.

options.title: Accept Existing Retention Semantics
options.body: Land the rebased PR after exact merge-head checks if maintainers agree that explicit cleanup should apply the existing deleted/reset archive retention policy.

options.title: Require Owner Policy Confirmation First
options.body: Pause merge until a session-state owner confirms the deletion/reporting behavior for stale deleted and reset archives.

options.title: Defer To Broader Artifact Cleanup Policy
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers want deleted/reset archive deletion bundled with a broader artifact-retention redesign.

recommendation.title: Accept Existing Retention Semantics
recommendation.body: Land the rebased PR after exact merge-head checks if maintainers agree that explicit cleanup should apply the existing deleted/reset archive retention policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They most directly own the archived-transcript retention helper being extended by this PR.
